# Vero Compass: October 2026

October was a bad month for us. The system stayed in altcoins all month and they fell hard, most of them around 20%, while Bitcoin only dropped 7%. We finished October down 21% after costs, 14 points behind just holding Bitcoin.

From our last high in August we were down 27% at the worst point. That's inside the range our backtest warned about (26 to 37%). But this is the live record, not a backtest, and we're not going to hide it.

We didn't change the rules because of one bad month. Below is exactly what we held, what each coin cost, and how to check every number yourself.

From 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-01 (daily opens, UTC). Every figure is computed from the public record and public prices, the same way as the record's headline table; see "Check it yourself" at the end.

## What the system did

- It began the month risk-on, holding ETH 23% · SOL 16% · ADA 3% · AVAX 10% · LINK 15% · GOLD 33% (call #4).
- On 2026-10-02 (call #5) it stayed risk-on: it sold gold, bought LTC, and kept ETH, SOL, ADA, AVAX and LINK. It then held ETH 26% · SOL 18% · ADA 15% · AVAX 11% · LINK 14% · LTC 16%.
  Call #5 was logged late: the indicator made the move before it was written here. The record counts it from 2026-10-02, as the entry says.
- On 2026-10-17 (call #6) it stayed risk-on: it sold ETH, bought DOT, and kept SOL, ADA, AVAX, LINK and LTC. It then held SOL 21% · ADA 17% · AVAX 11% · LINK 18% · LTC 18% · DOT 15%.
  Call #6 was logged late: the indicator made the move before it was written here. The record counts it from 2026-10-17, as the entry says.
- It ended the month risk-on, holding SOL 21% · ADA 17% · AVAX 11% · LINK 18% · LTC 18% · DOT 15%.

## The month's result

The record returned -21.0% after trading costs. Simply holding Bitcoin over the same days returned -7.2%.
The record lost money this month. Context: Bitcoin fell 7.2% over the same days.
That is 13.8 points behind simply holding Bitcoin. Context: the largest drag was SOL (-3.7 points).

## Drawdown and time below the previous high

Its deepest point this month was 27.0% below its previous high, and it spent 31 of the 31 days below that high. It ended the month 24.6% below it. Context: Bitcoin's deepest point over the same days was 10.7% below its own high since the record began.
The deepest point came on 2026-10-30, while the book held SOL 21% · ADA 17% · AVAX 11% · LINK 18% · LTC 18% · DOT 15%.
Its previous high was set on 2026-08-26.

## Wins and losses

What helped:
- Gold: +0.1 points. Held for 1 of the 31 days; its price rose 0.3% over those days.

What hurt:
- SOL: -3.7 points. Held all 31 days; its price fell 19.1% over those days.
- ADA: -3.4 points. Held all 31 days; its price fell 21.7% over those days.
- LTC: -3.0 points. Held for 30 of the 31 days; its price fell 18.1% over those days.
- LINK: -2.8 points. Held all 31 days; its price fell 18.8% over those days.
- DOT: -2.7 points. Held for 15 of the 31 days; its price fell 20.1% over those days.
- ETH: -2.5 points. Held for 16 of the 31 days; its price fell 9.8% over those days.
- AVAX: -2.3 points. Held all 31 days; its price fell 21.6% over those days.

Trading costs and small pricing differences: -0.6 points. The record charges a full exit and re-entry of the whole book at every call, including the holdings it keeps, so a follower who trades only the changes pays less.
